description: This PHP source file defines the EmailDao class, which is part of the OrangeHRM system's data access layer. It provides methods to retrieve Email entities by name and to fetch matching email templates based on various criteria such as email name, locale, recipient role, and performer role.

classes.name: EmailDao
classes.description: Data Access Object for Email related operations, extending the BaseDao class, providing methods to retrieve email data and email template matches based on specific criteria.

methods.name: getEmailByName
methods.description: Retrieves an Email entity by its name.

methods.name: getEmailTemplateMatches
methods.description: Fetches email templates matching the given email name, locale, and optional recipient and performer roles.
